main.description: A single event/activity record (an assembly, an open hours change, a workshop). One record per event, keyed by tid so multiple events coexist under one member's repo.

locationNote.description: Free text, deliberately not structured geo -- whether and how precisely to disclose location is a per-event, per-disclosure-tier choice (ESS_MESH_SPEC.md 3.5), not something this schema should make for the author by giving them a lat/lon field that implies it belongs in the public tier.
